name: DuckDB
description: Validate that OpenMetadata can open the DuckDB file and read its metadata.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that OpenMetadata can open the DuckDB database file in read-only mode.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to open the DuckDB database file. Check that the path exists on the machine running the ingestion and that no process holds it open for writing.

steps.name: GetSchemas
steps.description: List all the schemas in the DuckDB database.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to list the schemas in the DuckDB database.

steps.name: GetTables
steps.description: List the tables belonging to a schema.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to list the tables belonging to a schema.

steps.name: GetViews
steps.description: List the views belonging to a schema.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to list the views belonging to a schema.

steps.name: GetQueries
steps.description: Read query history from main.duckdb_query_log. Required only for usage and query lineage ingestion.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read main.duckdb_query_log. Usage and query lineage need this table; metadata, view lineage and profiling are not affected.
